package_info.package_name: OWASP LLM AI Security & Governance Checklist
package_info.package_manager: N/A (governance checklist, not a software package)
package_info.why_malicious: N/A – This is not a malicious package, but a security governance checklist designed to help organizations mitigate risks associated with large language model (LLM) and generative AI deployments.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This article does not describe any malicious code or attack chain. Instead, it summarizes the OWASP LLM AI Security & Governance Checklist, which provides best practices and actionable items for organizations to secure and govern their use of LLMs and generative AI. Detection strategies should focus on implementing the checklist’s recommendations, such as maintaining an AI asset inventory, performing threat modeling, ensuring regulatory compliance, and conducting red team exercises for AI systems.
